name: Hui Yang
description: Hui Yang is a Ph.D. candidate at Hunan University and a visiting Ph.D. student at the National University of Singapore, working on robotics and 3D vision.
biography: I’m a Ph.D. candidate at Hunan University, advised by Prof. Wei Sun. I’m also a visiting Ph.D. student at the National University of Singapore, advised by Prof. Gim Hee Lee.
My research interests include robotics, with a focus on manipulation, robot perception, and embodied AI, as well as 3D vision, including physical scene understanding and 3D reconstruction.

experience.detail: Computer Vision and Robotic Perception (CVRP) Lab
